text: Nora H: heads-up from the nightly link scan found a cluster of 404s on docs/faq/index.md in staging. Several FAQ anchors and one example embed are broken. Filing here so we can coordinate quick fix. link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-25T23:02Z - 10 dead internal links detected in docs/faq/index.md; samples: /faq#index-auth-flow (anchor), /examples/snippets/session-refresh.js (404). Full report: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/3579511234 Ben C: thanks Nora. I think the FAQ headings were consolidated in the last editorial pass and a couple anchors were removed. I can patch the anchors today. Support Squad: FYI this one affects a support KB article (KB-1342) that links into /faq#index-auth-flow. If you change the visible heading, please add an alias so the KB doesn't break for customers. Nora H: yep prefer alias anchors rather than renaming visible headings. Also the example embed came from a 3rd-party gist that GH started 403ing; recommend rehosting under /static/snippets/ and updating the iframe. Ben C: plan: 1) add legacy anchors above the new headings for compatibility (e.g., ), 2) rehost the snippet under /static/snippets/session-refresh.js and swap the embed src, 3) include a changelog note and the scan link in the PR. Quick local commands I used to find instances: ```bash rg "#index-auth-flow|session-refresh.js|/faq#index-auth-flow" -n docs/ && \ # then manually insert anchor comments in faq file and upload snippet to CDN bucket ``` Support Squad: that sounds perfect. If you can also add a tiny line in the PR body: "affects KB-1342" that helps our triage. Ben C: will do. @docs-oncall, can you merge small low-risk docs patches if CI is green? We'd like staging fixed before tomorrow's onboarding. docs-oncall: oncall here yes for small anchor + static asset updates we typically merge after CI passes. Tag me when ready and include the scan link + affected KB note. Ben C: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/9001 adds legacy anchors, swaps embed to /static/snippets/session-refresh.js, and includes changelog: "docs(faq): restore legacy anchors + rehost session-refresh snippet (KB-1342)". Tagged @Nora H and @Support Squad for context. Nora H: thanks Ben. Small nit: keep the anchor ids exactly as they were (case sensitive) so external bookmarks don't break. Ben C: confirmed ids unchanged. Also added a short comment above each anchor explaining the alias. Pushed and running local smoke test of the static build. link-scan-bot: awaiting merge. Will re-run scan after merge to validate. Ben C: CI green. Requesting merge. docs-oncall: merging now. Triggering post-merge scan. link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled post-merge. Support Squad: thanks all will update KB-1342 to point to the canonical FAQ anchor just in case, but the alias keeps things stable. Nora H: lovely, appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll close the support ticket if the re-scan shows green. :white_check_mark:
